standard.summary: 选择 UNet/DiT 中 self-attention 的计算后端。self-attention 是扩散模型中最昂贵的操作之一（O(n²) 复杂度），不同后端在速度和显存上差异可达 2-3 倍。
standard.effect: SDPA（Scaled Dot-Product Attention）是 PyTorch 2.0+ 内置的融合入口，自动选择 cutlass/flash/math 子后端。Flash Attention 2 用 tiling 算法将 attention 显存从 O(n²) 降到 O(n)，在高分辨率时优势巨大。SageAttn 用 INT8 量化 Q/K 矩阵进一步加速。SpargeAttn2 利用 attention 稀疏性跳过接近零的注意力权重。

recommendedValues.auto: 默认推荐。系统自动选择最优可用后端
recommendedValues.flash2: 有 Flash2 环境时的最佳选择（RTX 30xx/40xx，需 Ampere+）
recommendedValues.sageattn: 比 Flash2 快 20-30%，但有轻微量化精度损失
recommendedValues.sdpa: 兼容性最好，无需额外安装。速度中等
recommendedValues.spargeattn2: 最快但仍是实验性，仅支持特定硬件和形状（本选择器里没有：它绑定独立运行时环境 python-spargeattn2，需要在该环境下启动训练才可用，通用列表里不提供。）

standard.whenToUse: auto 通常就够用。如果你有 Flash2 环境，显式设 flash2 可以获得最稳定的加速。高分辨率（≥1536px）训练时 attention 后端的差异最明显——Flash2 比 SDPA 快 2-3 倍。
standard.avoidWhen: 不要在不支持的硬件上强制选高级后端（会报错或静默 fallback）。sdpa_backend_policy 控制 SDPA 内部子后端选择（cutlass/flash/cudnn/math），通常不需要手动调。attention_early_deletion 在 attention 计算后立即释放 Q/K/V tensor 以节省显存。

optionDescriptions.sageattn: SageAttention，常常更快，精度上可能有一点点取舍。
optionDescriptions.torch: 最朴素的 torch attention，慢，好对比。

standard_en.summary: Picks the backend that computes self-attention in the UNet/DiT. Self-attention is one of the costliest operations in a diffusion model (O(n^2) complexity), and backends can differ by 2-3x in both speed and memory.
standard_en.effect: SDPA (Scaled Dot-Product Attention) is the fused entry point built into PyTorch 2.0+, which picks a cutlass/flash/math sub-backend automatically. Flash Attention 2 tiles the computation to bring attention memory from O(n^2) down to O(n), a huge advantage at high resolution. SageAttn quantises Q/K to INT8 for extra speed. SpargeAttn2 exploits attention sparsity to skip weights that are near zero.
standard_en.whenToUse: auto is usually enough. If you have a Flash2 environment, setting flash2 explicitly gives the most consistent speed-up. The gap between backends shows most at high resolution (>=1536px), where Flash2 runs 2-3x faster than SDPA.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not force an advanced backend on hardware that cannot run it (you get an error or a silent fallback). sdpa_backend_policy governs SDPA's internal sub-backend choice (cutlass/flash/cudnn/math) and rarely needs tuning. attention_early_deletion frees the Q/K/V tensors immediately after attention to save memory.

optionDescriptions.auto: Uses whatever the launch environment has.
optionDescriptions.xformers: xFormers; the matching version has to be installed.
optionDescriptions.sageattn: SageAttention, often faster, with a small possible trade in precision.
optionDescriptions.torch: The plainest torch attention: slow, good for comparison.

recommendedValues.auto: The recommended default. The system picks the best available backend.
recommendedValues.flash2: The best choice where Flash2 is available (RTX 30xx/40xx, Ampere or newer).
recommendedValues.sageattn: 20-30% faster than Flash2, with a slight quantisation precision loss.
recommendedValues.sdpa: The most compatible option, nothing extra to install. Middling speed.
recommendedValues.spargeattn2: Fastest but still experimental, and only for particular hardware and shapes. (Not in this selector: it is bound to the separate python-spargeattn2 runtime and only works when training is launched in that environment, so the general list does not offer it.)

advanced.principle: Self-attention 计算 softmax(Q·K^T/√d)·V。标准实现需要保存完整的 attention matrix（n×n 元素），显存 O(n²)。Flash Attention 的 online softmax 算法将 Q/K/V 分成 tile（通常 128×128），逐 tile 计算并累积 softmax 归一化常数，不需要保存完整 attention matrix。SageAttn 将 Q 和 K 量化到 INT8 做矩阵乘法，然后反量化到 FP16 做 softmax，利用 INT8 Tensor Core 加速。SageAttn 的量化误差可能导致 attention 权重轻微偏移——sageattn_drift_check_interval 可以每 N 步与 SDPA 对比检测漂移。
advanced.intervention: diffusers 路径：替换 UNet 的 attention processor（AttnProcessor2_0 / FlashAttnProcessor / SageAttnProcessor）。native DiT 路径（Anima/Newbie）：替换 attention function 调用。Lulynx 在 execution_manifest.py 中定义了每个 execution profile 支持哪些 attention backend，TrainingExecutionResolver 在训练前验证所选 backend 是否可用。
advanced.expectedImpact: SDXL 1024px batch=1 训练（RTX 4090）：Flash2 ≈ 4.1 it/s（相对 SDPA +46%）；SageAttn ≈ 5.0 it/s（+79%）。对 LoRA 质量影响：Flash2 vs SDPA < 0.1% FID 差异（数学等价）；SageAttn vs Flash2 约 0.3-0.5% FID 差异（量化误差）。
advanced.tradeoffs: spargeattn2 在支持的硬件上最快但只支持特定分辨率和 head_dim。flexattn 使用 PyTorch 的 FlexAttention API 支持自定义 mask（如 sliding window），是 Blackwell 架构的实验性选项。execution_profile_id 决定了可用的 attention backend 范围——flash2 profile 预装了 flash-attn 包。
advanced.codePath: trainer.py:apply_attention_to_unet → diffusers AttnProcessor or native attention function; execution_resolver.py:validate attention backend availability

advanced_en.principle: Self-attention computes softmax(Q·K^T/√d)·V. The standard implementation must save the full attention matrix (n×n elements) — O(n²) memory. Flash Attention's online-softmax algorithm tiles Q/K/V (typically 128×128), computing tile by tile while accumulating the softmax normalization constants, needing no full attention matrix. SageAttn quantizes Q and K to INT8 for the matmul, then dequantizes to FP16 for softmax, exploiting INT8 Tensor Cores. SageAttn's quantization error can slightly shift attention weights — sageattn_drift_check_interval can compare against SDPA every N steps to detect drift.
advanced_en.intervention: diffusers path: replaces the UNet's attention processor (AttnProcessor2_0 / FlashAttnProcessor / SageAttnProcessor). Native DiT path (Anima/Newbie): replaces the attention function call. Lulynx defines in execution_manifest.py which attention backends each execution profile supports, and TrainingExecutionResolver validates the chosen backend's availability before training.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: SDXL 1024px batch=1 training (RTX 4090): Flash2 ≈ 4.1 it/s (+46% over SDPA); SageAttn ≈ 5.0 it/s (+79%). LoRA quality impact: Flash2 vs SDPA < 0.1% FID difference (mathematically equivalent); SageAttn vs Flash2 about 0.3-0.5% FID (quantization error).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: spargeattn2 is fastest on supporting hardware but only supports specific resolutions and head_dim. flexattn uses PyTorch's FlexAttention API supporting custom masks (e.g. sliding window) — an experimental option for Blackwell. execution_profile_id bounds the available attention backends — the flash2 profile preinstalls flash-attn.
advanced_en.codePath: trainer.py:apply_attention_to_unet → diffusers AttnProcessor or native attention function; execution_resolver.py:validate attention backend availability
